title: Praxis with a rectangular lift and a degree-17 seed field
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 6724 MiB (6.5662 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 2153059 million field multiplications (16974 and 2136086), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n, DenseSIS, msis_bound) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
